title: Receipt Parser for Totals and Line Items from Photos
description: Reads photographed shop receipts, straightens and cleans the image, then extracts store, date, line items and total, flagging results where the items do not add up to the printed total.

title: Chart Image to Data Table Extraction
description: Recovers approximate numeric values from bar and line chart images by detecting axes, ticks and marks, and reports how close the reconstructed table is to the original data.

title: Leaf Area Measurement from Phone Photos
description: Estimates the area of leaves photographed on a sheet with a reference square by thresholding and counting pixels, then tracks growth over several days.

title: Dominant Colour Palette Extractor for Designers
description: Extracts a small, visually distinct colour palette from an image using clustering, and exports it with hex codes and contrast ratios for accessible text choices.

title: Traffic Sign Recognition with a Compact CNN
description: Classifies road signs from cropped images with a compact convolutional network and tests how accuracy drops under blur, glare and partial occlusion.

title: Keyframe-Based Video Summariser
description: Condenses a long video into a handful of representative frames by detecting scene changes and removing near-identical shots, and builds a contact-sheet summary.

title: Motion Detection Camera with Region Masks
description: Records clips only when movement occurs inside user-drawn regions of a camera view, ignoring trees swaying or screens flickering in masked-out areas.

title: Badminton Court Line Detection and Shot Placement Map
description: Detects the court lines in match video, maps shuttle landing points into court coordinates with a homography, and charts where each player's shots land.

title: Seed Counting and Size Distribution from Images
description: Counts seeds spread on a tray and measures their sizes using watershed splitting for touching seeds, producing a size histogram a grower can use for grading.

title: Tree Canopy Segmentation from Drone Images
description: Segments tree canopy from orthomosaic drone tiles and estimates canopy cover per plot, comparing a classical vegetation index approach with a trained segmentation network.

title: Solder Joint Inspection on Circuit Boards
description: Classifies solder joints on board photographs as acceptable, bridged or missing, locating each joint first and explaining the decision with highlighted regions.

title: Near-Duplicate Photo Finder for Large Libraries
description: Finds photos that are near copies, such as resized or recompressed versions, with perceptual hashing and groups them so a user can keep the best of each cluster.

title: Sudoku Grid Reader from a Photograph
description: Locates a printed sudoku puzzle in a photo, corrects the perspective, recognises each digit and passes the grid to a solver, reporting cells it could not read confidently.

title: Whiteboard Capture with Rectification and Enhancement
description: Turns a slanted photo of a whiteboard into a clean, evenly lit page by finding its corners, flattening it and removing shadows, ready to share as a PDF.

title: Analogue Gauge and Meter Reader
description: Reads the value shown on a dial gauge from a photo by locating the needle and the scale marks, and converts the angle into a reading with an estimate of the error.

title: Camera Calibration and Lens Distortion Correction Tool
description: Calibrates a camera from chessboard photographs, computes its intrinsic parameters and straightens distorted images, reporting the reprojection error for each calibration photo.

title: Vehicle Speed Estimation with Optical Flow
description: Estimates the speed of vehicles in roadside video by tracking motion and converting pixel displacement to metres using a measured reference distance, validated against known speeds.

title: Building Footprint Extraction from Aerial Tiles
description: Outlines buildings on aerial image tiles with a segmentation model and converts masks into clean polygons that can be loaded into a map layer.

title: Face Blurring Privacy Filter for Videos
description: Detects faces in a video and blurs them frame by frame, keeping the blur steady when a detection briefly drops out between frames.

title: Printed Sheet Music Symbol Recognition
description: Detects staff lines and recognises note heads, rests and clefs in a scanned score, then produces a playable representation of a single melody line.

title: Chess Position Recognition from a Board Photo
description: Reads the pieces on a physical chessboard from a photograph, converts the position to standard notation and checks that the result is a legal position.

title: Posture Monitor for Desk Workers via Webcam
description: Estimates head and shoulder angles from a webcam and nudges the user when they slump for too long, with all video processed locally and never stored.

title: Fabric Pattern Defect Detection
description: Detects flaws such as snags and misprinted patterns in textile images by learning what normal fabric looks like and flagging regions that differ.

title: Coin Counter from a Tabletop Photo
description: Finds round coins in a photo, classifies them by size and then totals their value, using a reference coin for scale and reporting overlapping coins it cannot separate.

title: Colony Counting on Petri Dish Images
description: Counts bacterial colonies on culture plate photographs, splits touching colonies and reports counts with an uncertainty estimate for use in teaching laboratories.

title: Handwriting Slant and Spacing Analyser for Penmanship Practice
description: Measures slant, letter spacing and baseline consistency in a photo of handwriting and gives practice feedback, without trying to read the text itself.
